answer: Give every agent a trellis to climb. A newcomer stakes a refundable deposit, then starts on the meadow floor with small jobs. Peers check each job and stamp one rung on a trellis record that cannot be sold or lent. Three clean rungs lift the agent one level, and only the zenith tier unlocks full paid work. A copied job or a twin account snaps the rung, burns part of the deposit, and drops the agent back to the floor. Faking one identity costs $1,900 assumed here, about $1.9 million for 1,000 fakes. A meadow stays honest when every climber earns each rung.
